title: Bano ki sada thi
body:
bano ki sada thi yehi faryad hai faryad
ay sayyede sajjad
kya honge na hum qaide sitam kabhi azad
ay sayyede sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
ek roz may taraaj hua mera bhara ghar
kaisa tha muqaddar
socha bhi na tha honge hum is tarha se barbaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
cheh maah ke baysheer ki wo tashna dahani
paaya nahi pani
kya kya na huwe bali sakina pe bhi bedaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
hal min ki sada shaah ne di ran may kayi baar
koi na tha ghamkhar
khanjar se zibha karta raha shaah ko jallaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
maare gaye abbas e alamdar hamare
darya ke kanare
kha kar sina dunya se gaye akbar e nashaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
aada se kaho chaahe meri jaan bhi lele
chadar meri dede
be-parda phiraye na hamay ye sitam ejaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
hum qaid se chutenge watan jayenge kyun kar
akbar hai na asghar
ab wo kahan sughra jinhe karti hai bahot yaad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha ho mera aur dare shaah e huda ho
nazim ki sada ho
mehshar ka kalaam ban gaya hai aap ki faryad
ay sayyede sajjad
bano ki sada thi yehi…
author: Mehshar Lakhnavi
